description: Analyze signal spectra in MATLAB using nonparametric and parametric estimators. Use when computing frequency content, PSD, power spectrum, spectral peaks, bandwidth, or streaming spectral analysis. Covers pspectrum, pwelch, periodogram, pmtm, pburg, pmusic, rootmusic, plomb, poctave, spectrumAnalyzer, dsp.SpectrumEstimator. TRIGGER: FFT, PSD, power spectrum, spectral analysis, frequency content, bandwidth measurement, spectral leakage, window selection, streaming spectrum, periodicity, resolve close frequencies, multitaper. DO NOT TRIGGER: filter design, spectrogram/time-frequency, audio features.
